description: d_min=0.08 — tail from month 30 onward holds at 3,300-3,600 bbl/month, indicating terminal decline well above 5%
b_initial=1.0 — current b=0.68 produces steep late-time decline but months 22-36 flatten; higher b_initial to find slower-decline local minimum
qi_guess_strategy=peak_value — peak at month 3 (25,315 bbl) vs first month (12,365); anchoring decline from peak may improve forecast
significance_threshold=0.70 — first 3 months are ramp-up (12k to 25k bbl), not decline; higher threshold to better detect peak and exclude ramp-up from fit
outlier_threshold=0.15 — several months deviate sharply from trend (Oct 2023 drops 35%, Sep 2024 drops 25%); more aggressive outlier removal for cleaner fit
peak_merge_distance=7 — ramp-up months 1-3 may create multiple local peaks; wider merge to push decline start past ramp-up
smoothing_window=6 — heavy smoothing to dampen month-to-month volatility; changes actual data values fed to optimizer unlike prior params
smoothing_window=2 — less smoothing to preserve raw decline shape; more smoothing (v8) worsened MAPE, so try minimal smoothing
